content.title: What is Earth Day? 🌍 How to Help the Planet for Kids!
content.text: Happy Earth Day! 🌍✨ In this video, we’re going to learn all about Earth Day, this is the one day a year when the whole world comes together to celebrate our amazing planet! But more importantly, we’re sharing easy, fun ways that YOU can help keep the Earth healthy and green every single day! From the tallest mountains to the deepest oceans, Earth is our home, and it’s up to us to protect it. Ready to become a Planet Hero?
